Organizer: Priya
Required: Kenji Eriksen; Yara Fitzgerald; Gus Kowalczyk; Tariq Underhill; Ilse Cho; Odette Ishikawa; Vendor Representative (external)
When: Thursday 10:00 – 10:30
Where: Microsoft Teams Meeting / Lab B Conference Room

Dear colleagues,

Kindly please join the live demonstration of the vendor scheduling module for Ember 2.0. The vendor will show the software on our real assay data, so we can ask the questions directly and see the answers on screen. After the demo we must decide go or no-go for the pilot, because the quote is valid only until Friday.

Agenda:
1. Demo of plate reader data import, using our sample set (Vendor, 10 min). Kenji to provide the files before Wednesday.
2. Audit trail and 21 CFR Part 11 compliance questions (Ilse Cho, 7 min)
3. LIMS connection and IT security (Tariq Underhill, 5 min)
4. Pilot decision and next step (Yara Fitzgerald, Gus Kowalczyk, 8 min). Odette will take the notes and send the summary.

Please prepare your questions in advance and add them in the shared document, so we are not losing time. If you cannot attend, please send a delegate who is able to give opinion for your team.

Thank you for your cooperation.

Best regards,
Priya
Oakspring Biosciences

Date/Time: Wednesday, 3:30 PM – 4:00 PM
Location: HQ 4th Floor, Room Maple (vendor joining by video)
Attendees: Ivan, Pilar Gunawardena, Fern Grummond

Description:
Pilar, Fern,

I'm really sorry to drop this on your calendars with such short notice, and so late in the week too. The vendor only confirmed their availability this morning, and they won't have another slot until after our pilot stores go live, which would be too late to matter.

I kept the list to just the three of us on purpose. Pilar, you know the store-ops side of the Lattice rollout better than anyone, and Fern, you'd be the one supporting the integration with our pricing system, so I didn't want to make the call without both of you seeing it working.

Roughly what I'm hoping we cover:
- They walk through a price change pushed from HQ to a store's shelf labels
- What happens when a store loses connection mid-update (this is my biggest worry, honestly)
- Fern's questions about how it reads from our pricing feed
- A quick gut-check between us at the end: do we bring them into the pilot or keep looking

I've asked them to skip the company overview slides so we get straight to the product. If they start drifting into a sales pitch, please feel free to steer them back, I'll do the same.

If the time is truly impossible for either of you, let me know and I'll try to beg for another slot, though I can't promise anything.

Thanks for squeezing this in, and apologies again.

Ivan
Cedarline Home Goods"},{"spec_id":"spec_0195","text":"Lattice migration – stakeholder check-in

Description:
Hello all,

Sorry, I know this is the second time I move this meeting and also I know Friday before lunch is not the most loved slot. Apologies to everyone, especially Raj who already rearranged once for me.

I will not take too much of your time, it is only 30 minutes. Before we talk, please if possible look on these things:

• the sample tracking export which Esme shared on Tuesday
- Femi comments in the validation sheet (tab 3)
* the freezer inventory mapping, Xavier is still finishing it, so maybe it is not complete when you open

I prefer we can see together with everybody in the same call, because last time when we did by email the comments were going in different directions and it was little confusing for me to put together.

If somebody cannot join, please tell me before Thursday evening and maybe you can send someone from your team who can speak for the group.

Again sorry for the changes and thank you for your patience with me.

Fatima
Cedarstone Therapeutics
